statement.zh: 考古研究将瓦里表述为秘鲁中地平线以阿亚库乔高原中心向外扩张、并在库斯科等地建立行省行政中心的复杂社会（Schreiber 1992；Isbell & Schreiber 1978）。
statement.en: Research frames Wari as a Middle Horizon complex society expanding from a central highland Ayacucho centre and establishing provincial administrative centres including near Cuzco (Schreiber 1992; Isbell & Schreiber 1978).
